verdict.rationale: Opting out of analytics or usage tracking (for example, cookie consent controls) is a fair question for a public web service like impots.gouv.fr, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, cookies, analytics or any opt-out control. The only setting in evidence is a light/dark theme selector, which is unrelated.
